map.开四关以合谷配太冲为核心：合谷位于第一、二掌骨间桡侧中点（主头面与上肢诸疾），太: The Four Gates centers on Hegu paired with Taichong: Hegu lies at the midpoint of the radial side between the first and second metacarpal bones (governing disorders of the head, face and upper limbs), and Taichong lies on the dorsum of the foot between the first and second metatarsal bones (governing soothing the liver and regulating qi). Together they mainly treat qi stagnation and depression, headache and insomnia. Other common pairings are Neiguan with Gongsun (heart, chest and stomach), Zusanli with Zhongwan (strengthening the spleen and harmonizing the stomach), and Sanyinjiao with Guanyuan (nourishing the source and gynecology); 2 to 4 points are taken each time and the needles are retained for 20 to 30 minutes.
